question: Which state launched 7-Star Gram Panchayat Rainbow Scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Haryana Government has launched 7-Star Gram Panchayat Rainbow scheme to give star rankings to its panchayats based on 7 social parameters.
 
• The 7-Star Rainbow Scheme was launched by the Hon'ble Chief Minister, Haryana on 26th January 2018 with a focus on improving the working of Gram Panchayats in Haryana.</l
